issue_context.title: [scheduler] Improve Handling of Node Status
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

This issue is to track follow-ups from #125197, which addressed a performance issue related to the NodeToStatusMap. There are latent issues which we would like to address to prevent future regressions. We can either improve NodeToStatusMap to support some of the below operations more efficiently, or come up with different way to propagate these statuses through the scheduler.

current problems:
- we loop through all nodes to set the [same status](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/dae37c21645c0fc04bbb0202ad1eba6ba4438d23/pkg/scheduler/schedule_one.go#L458-L462)
  - w/ current implementation, only need to set Unschedulable status - see [comment](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/125197#discussion_r1621723775)
- we [loop through all nodes](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/dae37c21645c0fc04bbb0202ad1eba6ba4438d23/pkg/scheduler/framework/preemption/preemption.go#L419-L430) when determining preemption candidates, so that we can create an [error message](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/dae37c21645c0fc04bbb0202ad1eba6ba4438d23/pkg/scheduler/framework/types.go#L392-L397) based on the UnschedulableAndUnresolvable status. this error message can be generated more efficiently. also see [comment](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/125197/files#r1621778045)

other considerations:
- when operating over many nodes, hashing node name string is hotspot when doing hashmap gets/sets. consider creating a lightweight `NodeKey` type, which, for a scheduling cycle, references an existing node. This type should be cheap to hash  (+allow lookup in [flat data structure](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a2911e06a7cd393f7cce088b8399f889527b517f/pkg/scheduler/internal/cache/snapshot.go#L33)), and is safer than string node name, as it is guaranteed to reference a valid node.
- consider updating scheduler to not call postfilter plugins when all nodes are `UnschedulableAndUnresolvable`. at least, we should  reconcile the documented behavior [here](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a2911e06a7cd393f7cce088b8399f889527b517f/pkg/scheduler/framework/interface.go#L454-L456) and [here](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a2911e06a7cd393f7cce088b8399f889527b517f/pkg/scheduler/framework/interface.go#L90) and [here](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a2911e06a7cd393f7cce088b8399f889527b517f/pkg/scheduler/framework/interface.go#L97-L98)
- consider changing [Status](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a2911e06a7cd393f7cce088b8399f889527b517f/pkg/scheduler/framework/interface.go#L181) to an immutable type, so it can be safely shared.

/sig scheduling

### Why is this needed?

The current implementation includes some operations which may cause future performance regression. Additionally, there is some room for simplification.

> consider updating scheduler to not call postfilter plugins when all nodes are UnschedulableAndUnresolvable. 

I personally prefer this approach. This seems to be sufficient and the changes are relatively small.

> consider updating scheduler to not call postfilter plugins when all nodes are UnschedulableAndUnresolvable.

We cannot take this way, UnschedulableAndUnresolvable has the meaning only to plugin(s) that do preemption-ish stuff. 
But, there are some other usecases in PostFilter, such as record something, clean up something, etc when each scheduling fails.

> We cannot take this way, UnschedulableAndUnresolvable has the meaning only to plugin(s) that do preemption-ish stuff.
But, there are some other usecases in PostFilter, such as record something, clean up something, etc when each scheduling fails.

Ah right. We have already changed current behaviour to not set `UnschedulableAndUnresolvable` for allNodes if preFilter fails, not sure if this will break some custom postFilter plugins.
Then I think instead of `not call postfilter`, passing an empty NodeToStatus map may be enough. However, we'll need a new field in NodeToStatus map  to indicate that all nodes are `UnschedulableAndUnresolvable` for plugins.

> We cannot take this way, UnschedulableAndUnresolvable has the meaning only to plugin(s) that do preemption-ish stuff.

Still, the preemption plugin could exit early if can tell that all nodes where UnschedulableAndUnresolvable
@YamasouA this is not a task that is friendly to newcomers. Do you have experience writing code for the scheduler? Or perhaps you have someone that can mentor you already?
No worries Aldo, I'm with them.

I have been experimenting with these improvements over the past two weeks (#125954). Unfortunately, I forgot to assign myself to the issue, my bad. Nevertheless, the PR addresses only the "current problems" part of the improvements. I think the lightweight `NodeKey` and immutable `Status` types are still worth exploring, but in my opinion both would require changes in plugins' interface.

review_comments: why not absent node status here?

With current semantics, `AbsentNodeStatus` is used for `UnschedulableAndUnresolvable` status only, as this field is used for diagnosis messages and not propagated further. Setting the `AbsentNodeStatus` for Unresolvable nodes might break post filter plugins that receive only the `NodeToStatusMap` ([here](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/6a16d3ebb2dc912823cb1886df60e2ccc26b1001/pkg/scheduler/schedule_one.go#L176)).

If it would be possible to merge the map and absent status into one structure as described [above](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/125954#discussion_r1671818405), it will make it possible to set the `Unschedulable` status here using the `AbsentNodeStatus` field.

What do you think about coupling these together (AbsentNodesStatus and NodeToStatusMap) - perhaps by changing NodeToStatusMap to a struct?  `set`, `setAbsentStatus`, and `get` (which returns the absent status, if the value is not explicitly defined) would make it easier to use.

It does change the interface, but on the other hand this is going out in a new release, would give plugin developers a heads up to the semantics change, and provide us with future flexibility that the map type doesnt give.
That would be good and increase readability. The question is, if we can change the plugins interface that deep. @alculquicondor what do you think?
Created second PR #126022 to explore the possible solution you proposed here.
